## 1. Brand Philosophy & Core Essence

The **Ibrahim Benabida** brand identity is anchored on an intentional synthesis: **mathematical data science** paired with **high-end editorial digital design, software engineering, and cinematic motion**.

```
    ┌───────────────────────────┐         ┌───────────────────────────┐
    │       DATA SCIENCE        │         │      DIGITAL DESIGN       │
    │  Mathematical Modeling    │    ∩    │    Brand Systems, Figma   │
    │  USTHB Computer Science   │         │    Typography & Layout    │
    └─────────────┬─────────────┘         └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                  │                                     │
                  └─────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                                    ▼
                      ┌───────────────────────────┐
                      │    ibrahim. (UNIVERSAL)   │
                      │  High-Performance Web UI  │
                      │  Cinematic Motion & Video │
                      │  Algorithmic Visual Tone  │
                      └───────────────────────────┘
```

* **Tagline:** *Mathematical Rigor Meets Visual Clarity.*
* **Brand Persona:** The Creator-Scholar — analytical, precise, aesthetically uncompromising, and devoid of generic agency fluff.
* **Core Wordmark:** `ibrahim.` (all-lowercase, ending with a typographic full stop).

## 4. Video Editing & Motion Graphics Manual

This section defines the exact technical standards for video editors, motion graphic artists, and content creators working in **Adobe Premiere Pro**, **After Effects**, **DaVinci Resolve**, **Final Cut Pro**, or **CapCut**.

```
    16:9 LANDSCAPE (YOUTUBE / DESKTOP)          9:16 VERTICAL (REELS / TIKTOK / SHORTS)
    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐         ┌───────────────────┐
    │ [Logo Bug]                      │         │ [Top Safe Zone]   │
    │                                 │         │                   │
    │                                 │         │   SUBJECT / FACE  │
    │                                 │         │                   │
    │ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │         │ ┌───────────────┐ │
    │ │ LOWER THIRD: ibrahim.       │ │         │ │ CAPTIONS      │ │
    │ └─────────────────────────────┘ │         │ └───────────────┘ │
    └─────────────────────────────────┘         │ [Bottom Safe Zone]│
                                                └───────────────────┘
```

### 4.1 Color Grading Profile & LUT Settings

The video look is **filmic editorial**: deep warm shadows, organic natural skin tones, and creamy soft highlights. Never use cold digital blue tints or over-saturated HDR looks.

#### DaVinci Resolve / Premiere Pro Lumetri Color Targets

* **Color Space / Gamma:** Rec.709 / Gamma 2.4 (Standard Web / Broadcast).
* **Black Point & Shadows:**
  * Lift black point slightly to `IRE 2 - 4%` (never hard crush to 0% digital black).
  * Push warm reddish-burgundy into shadows: Lift Wheel Hue `0° - 5°` (Black Cherry `#5A1212`), Saturation `0.04 - 0.08`.
* **Midtones & Skin Tones:**
  * Keep skin tones anchored directly along the standard Rec.709 Skin Tone Line on the Vectorscope.
  * Neutral-warm temperature (`5400K - 5600K`). Avoid excessive orange spray-tan grading.
* **Highlights & White Point:**
  * Roll off peak highlights softly at `IRE 92 - 95%` into warm Soft Linen `#E8E3D9`.
  * Eliminate harsh digital clipping on specular reflections.

---

### 4.2 Aspect Ratios, Frame Rates & Safe Zones

| Format | Resolution | Aspect Ratio | Frame Rate | Primary Platform | Safe Zone Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cinematic / Long-Form** | `3840 × 2160` (4K) or `1920 × 1080` (FHD)| `16:9` | **24.00 fps** | YouTube, Portfolio, Desktop | Standard Title Safe (80%), Action Safe (90%) |
| **Short-Form / Reels** | `1080 × 1920` | `9:16` | **30.00 / 60.00 fps** | Instagram Reels, TikTok, Shorts | Top 250px & Bottom 380px Safe Margin |
| **Social Square** | `1080 × 1080` | `1:1` | **24.00 / 30.00 fps** | LinkedIn Feed, Twitter/X, Instagram Grid | Margin 60px all sides |
| **UI Screen Recordings** | Native / `1920 × 1080` | `16:9` or `16:10` | **60.00 fps** | Web Demos, Software Showcases | Full viewport with cursor smoothing |

```
├───────────────────────────────────────────┤  y = 250px

│   └───────────────────────────────────┘   │
```

### 4.3 Lower Thirds System & Chyron Template

Lower thirds must appear architectural and disciplined, echoing the website's grid layout.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [ ◎ BADGE ]  ibrahim.                                                  │
│              DATA SCIENCE UNDERGRADUATE • DIGITAL DESIGNER             │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### Specifications:
* **Container:**
  * Background: Black Cherry `#5A1212` with 88% opacity (`rgba(90, 18, 18, 0.88)`).
  * Border: `1px solid rgba(232, 227, 217, 0.40)` (Soft Linen hairline).
  * Padding: `16px 24px`.
  * Placement: Bottom-left on 16:9 (offset `120px` from left edge, `100px` from bottom edge).
* **Badge:** Circular Golden Angle badge (`golden-angle-badge-dark.svg`), diameter `48px`.
* **Primary Text:**
  * Content: `ibrahim.` (strictly lowercase with period).
  * Font: Space Grotesk Bold (700), size `32px` (`pt`), tracking `-0.06em`.
  * Color: Soft Linen `#E8E3D9`.
* **Secondary Text:**
  * Content: `DATA SCIENCE UNDERGRADUATE • DIGITAL DESIGNER`
  * Font: Space Grotesk SemiBold (600), size `14px` (`pt`), tracking `+0.08em` (UPPERCASE).
  * Color: Soft Linen `#E8E3D9` with 75% opacity.
* **Animation Timing:**
  * **In (0.5s):** Slides in from left with `-10deg` skew, easing `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
  * **Hold:** 4.0 - 6.0 seconds.
  * **Out (0.4s):** Fades and scales down slightly (`scale(0.98)`).

---

### 4.4 Kinetic Typography, Captions & Subtitles

Subtitles in talking-head videos must follow the brand's typographic rules:

* **Font:** Space Grotesk Bold (700).
* **Casing:** Natural lowercase emphasis (echoing `ibrahim.`) or clean sentence case. Avoid all-caps screaming subtitles.
* **Color Formatting:**
  * Inactive / Spoken Words: Soft Linen `#E8E3D9`.
  * Active / Highlighted Word: Black Cherry `#5A1212` on a Soft Linen pill backdrop (`#E8E3D9` rounded box), or inverse.
* **Line Length:** Maximum 3 to 5 words per subtitle screen for instant readability.
* **Drop Shadow / Stroke:**
  * Avoid heavy cartoon black strokes (`-webkit-text-stroke: 4px black` is forbidden).
  * Use a subtle 20% directional soft shadow (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0px 4px 12px`) or a frosted semi-transparent pill backing.

---

### 4.5 Motion Physics, Animation Curves & Stingers

All brand motion must feel **mechanical, purposeful, and weighted**, like precision Swiss machinery or mathematical computation. Avoid bouncy cartoon springs.

#### Primary Easing Curves

| Easing Type | Cubic-Bezier Coordinates | Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Signature Transition** | `cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1)` | Full-screen sweep, modal reveals, scene cuts |
| **Snappy UI Pop** | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | Badges, buttons, lower thirds entering |
| **Decelerated Settle** | `cubic-bezier(0.0, 0, 0.2, 1)` | Text fades, camera zooms, layout sliding |

#### The Signature "Theme Sweep" Transition
A full-screen wipe featuring a parallelogram curtain skewed at `-10°`:
* Skew Angle: `-10deg` (`skewX(-10deg)`).
* Sequence: Left-to-right sweep across the viewport from `-115%` to `+115%`.
* Curtain Color: Black Cherry `#5A1212` (wiping into dark scene) or Soft Linen `#E8E3D9` (wiping into light scene).
* Duration: `600ms - 800ms`.

#### Logo Stinger / Intro Animation (After Effects / Motion)
1. **Phyllotaxis Spiral Cascade (0.0s – 1.2s):**
   * The nodes of the Golden Angle emblem appear sequentially from node $0$ at the origin outward to node $120$.
   * Each node scales up from `0%` to `100%` along the $137.5^\circ$ angular progression.
2. **Wordmark Assembly (1.2s – 1.8s):**
   * The emblem shifts smoothly to the left.
   * The letters of `ibrahim.` track in from `-0.15em` to `-0.09em` with opacity fade.
   * The trailing dot `.` drops into place with a subtle mechanical stamp.
3. **Outro Dissolve (2.4s – 2.8s):**
   * Smooth fade into video content or hard cut on an audio beat.

---

### 4.6 Sound Design & Sonic Identity

Audio gives weight to motion graphics. The brand sonic palette is:

* **Core Timbre:** Acoustic, tactile, computational, low-frequency resonance.
* **UI Interactions:** Real tactile mechanical keystrokes (Cherry MX silent black feel), subtle camera shutter clicks, soft paper page turns.
* **Scene Transitions / Sweeps:** Soft warm sub-bass drop (`50Hz - 70Hz` sine wave hit at `-6dB`) accompanied by an organic air whoosh.
* **Forbidden Audio:**
  * ✗ No generic corporate upbeat ukulele whistle tracks.
  * ✗ No loud EDM dubstep drops, risers, or vinyl scratches.
  * ✗ No high-pitch cartoon notification dings.

For physical stationery, posters, business cards, stickers, and exhibition banners.

```
    BUSINESS CARD (85mm x 55mm)
    FRONT (Black Cherry)                        BACK (Soft Linen)
    ┌─────────────────────────────┐             ┌─────────────────────────────┐
    │                             │             │ ibrahim.                    │
    │            ◎                │             │ ─────────────────────────── │
    │      (BLIND DEBOSSED        │             │ Ibrahim Benabida            │
    │       GOLDEN ANGLE)         │             │ Data Science & Digital Design│
    │                             │             │ USTHB Algiers               │
    │          ibrahim.           │             │ ibrahimbenabida.online      │
    └─────────────────────────────┘             └─────────────────────────────┘
```

### 5.1 Business Card Specifications
* **Standard Dimensions:** `85mm × 55mm` (EU/International) or `3.5in × 2.0in` (US).
* **Bleed Margin:** `3mm` (`0.125in`) on all four sides.
* **Paper Stock:**
  * Weight: `380 - 450 gsm` heavy premium cotton or linen-textured stock (e.g. G.F Smith Colorplan or Fedrigoni Materica).
  * Texture: Natural tactile matte finish (never high-gloss plastic UV).
* **Finishing Techniques:**
  * **Front Face:** Solid Black Cherry `#5A1212` background flood. The Golden Angle phyllotaxis emblem is **blind debossed** (pressed into the paper without ink) to create tactile relief. The `ibrahim.` wordmark is stamped in matte Soft Linen foil.
  * **Back Face:** Clean Soft Linen `#E8E3D9` paper ground with high-contrast Graphite `#332D2B` typography and a 1px hairline divider grid.

---

### 5.2 Clear Space & Isolation Grids

```
         ┌─────────────────────────┐
         │ 1X                      │
         │   ┌─────────────────┐   │
         │   │   ◎ EMBLEM      │   │
         │1X │                 │1X │
         │   └─────────────────┘   │
         │                      1X │
         └─────────────────────────┘
```

* **Clear Space Rule ($1X$):** The minimum isolation margin around the Golden Angle emblem or master wordmark must equal the radius $X$ of the outer spiral node ring.
* **No Intrusion:** No text, icons, competing graphics, or busy photographic elements may enter the $1X$ perimeter.

---

### 5.3 Editorial Print Layout Guidelines

* **Grid:** 12-column Swiss typographic grid with visible hairlines (`0.25pt` stroke in Graphite).
* **Margins:** Asymmetrical margins (e.g., top `24mm`, bottom `32mm`, outer `20mm`, inner gutter `28mm`).
* **Color Profiles:** Convert all RGB assets to **CMYK Fogra39** (Europe) or **SWOP v2** (US) prior to plate output.

---

## 6. Typography System & Space Grotesk Rules

The master typographic voice is driven by **Space Grotesk** by Florian Karsten.

```
       Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg Hh Ii Jj Kk Ll Mm
       Nn Oo Pp Qq Rr Ss Tt Uu Vv Ww Xx Yy Zz
       0123456789 .,:;!?@#$%&*()
```

### 6.1 Hierarchy & Sizing Rules

| Scale Tier | Font Weight | Letter Spacing | Desktop Clamp | Mobile Size | Intent |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Monumental Mark** | Bold (700) | `-0.10em` | `clamp(4.5rem, 13vw, 10.5rem)` | `3.8rem - 5.5rem` | `ibrahim.` hero wordmark |
| **Section Anchor** | Bold (700) | `-0.06em` | `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)` | `2.25rem - 3rem` | `The designer.`, `SELECTED works.` |
| **Project Title** | Bold (700) | `-0.04em` | `2rem - 2.5rem` | `1.5rem - 1.75rem` | Case study headings |
| **Subheadings** | Medium (500)| `-0.02em` | `1.125rem - 1.25rem` | `1rem` | Secondary descriptions |
| **Body Paragraph** | Regular (400)| Normal | `1rem` (16px) / line-height 1.6 | `15px - 16px` | Editorial bio copy |
| **Micro Index Tag** | SemiBold (600)| `+0.08em` | `0.75rem` (12px, UPPERCASE) | `11px` | `/ VIEW ALL WORKS /` |

### 6.2 Mandatory Editorial Rules

1. **The Lowercase Wordmark:**  
   Always write `ibrahim.` in lowercase with the trailing period. Never capitalize (`Ibrahim.`, `IBRAHIM.`).
2. **The Section Punctuation Rule:**  
   Major landing section headers terminate in a full stop:
   * `The designer.`
   * `SELECTED works.`
   * `MY services.`
   * `WANT TO chat?.`
3. **The Definite Article Rule:**  
   Always write **`The designer.`** with "The" preceding the word. Never leave it naked as `designer.`.
4. **Architectural Marquee Delimiters:**  
   Categorical strings are spaced with optical forward slashes:  
   `/ MATHEMATICAL MODELING / DIGITAL DESIGN / USTHB ALGIERS / DATA SCIENCE /`

---

## 7. Algorithmic Pattern System & CSS Masking

The brand includes 5 custom algorithmic pattern motifs:
1. **`rings`**: Orbital harmonic waves (concentric loops). Used on the `/links` page and hero brand seal container.
2. **`bloom`**: Full sunflower seed phyllotaxis expansion.
3. **`cluster`**: Clustered data nodes representing algorithms.
4. **`halftone`**: Structured square/dot raster matrix.
5. **`ripple`**: Water interference contours.

### CSS Masking Implementation

```css
/* Non-destructive pattern backdrop with variable opacity */
.brand-patterned {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  background-color: var(--soft-linen);
}

.brand-patterned::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-color: var(--black-cherry);
  opacity: 0.18; /* Keep between 0.12 and 0.25 to prevent clashing with text */
  -webkit-mask: url("/patterns/web-tiles/tile-rings-cherry.svg") repeat;
          mask: url("/patterns/web-tiles/tile-rings-cherry.svg") repeat;
}
```

## 8. Software Development & Implementation Kit

### 8.1 React / Next.js Component (`BrandLogo.tsx`)

Save this file directly to `src/components/BrandLogo.tsx`:

```tsx
import React from 'react';

interface BrandLogoProps {
  variant?: 'symbol' | 'badge' | 'wordmark' | 'full';
  theme?: 'cherry' | 'linen' | 'current';
  size?: number | string;
  className?: string;
}

export const BrandLogo: React.FC<BrandLogoProps> = ({
  variant = 'full',
  theme = 'current',
  size,
  className = '',
}) => {
  const fillColor =
    theme === 'cherry'
      ? '#5A1212'
      : theme === 'linen'
      ? '#E8E3D9'
      : 'currentColor';

  if (variant === 'badge') {
    const isDark = theme === 'linen';
    return (
      <svg
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        viewBox="10 10 380 380"
        width={size || 40}
        height={size || 40}
        className={className}
        aria-label="Ibrahim Benabida Badge"
      >
        <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill={isDark ? '#5A1212' : '#E8E3D9'} />
        <path
          fill={isDark ? '#E8E3D9' : '#5A1212'}
          d="M191.8 207.0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 1.2 0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 -1.2 0zM200.6 185.4a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 1.3 0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 -1.3 0zM210.2 214.2a0.7 0.7 0 1 0 1.3 0a0.7 0.7 0 1 0 -1.3 0z"
        />
      </svg>
    );
  }

  if (variant === 'symbol') {
    return (
      <svg
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        viewBox="30 30 340 340"
        width={size || 32}
        height={size || 32}
        className={className}
        aria-label="Golden Angle Symbol"
      >
        <path
          fill={fillColor}
          d="M191.8 207.0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 1.2 0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 -1.2 0zM200.6 185.4a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 1.3 0a0.6 0.6 0 1 0 -1.3 0zM210.2 214.2a0.7 0.7 0 1 0 1.3 0a0.7 0.7 0 1 0 -1.3 0z"
        />
      </svg>
    );
  }

  // Master Full Lockup
  return (
    <svg
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 1585 380"
      width={size || 220}
      height="auto"
      className={className}
      aria-label="ibrahim. logo"
    >
      <g transform="translate(-10 -10)">
        <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill={theme === 'linen' ? '#5A1212' : '#E8E3D9'} />
```

### 8.3 Python Mathematical Coordinate Generator

Use this script to mathematically generate any scale or resolution of the Golden Angle pattern:

```python
import math

def generate_phyllotaxis_points(num_points=120, scaling_constant=12.0):
    golden_angle_rad = math.radians(137.507764)
    points = []
    
    for n in range(num_points):
        r = scaling_constant * math.sqrt(n)
        theta = n * golden_angle_rad
        x = r * math.cos(theta)
        y = r * math.sin(theta)
        points.append((round(x, 2), round(y, 2)))
        
    return points

# Example: Generate first 10 coordinate pairs centered at origin
coords = generate_phyllotaxis_points(10)
for idx, (x, y) in enumerate(coords):
    print(f"Node {idx:02d}: x={x:6.2f}, y={y:6.2f}")
```
